A, B.description: Empirical constants (A ≈ 97 MPa, B ≈ 8 for Type I at 28 days)

title: Absolute Volume Method
equation: V_FA = 1.0 - V_cement - V_water - V_CA - V_air - V_SCM

V.description: Volume of each component (m³ per m³ of concrete)

title: Required Average Strength (with data)
equation: f'cr = max(f'c + 1.34s, f'c + 2.33s - 3.45) for f'c ≤ 35 MPa

s.description: Standard deviation of test results (≥ 30 tests)

title: Aggregate Moisture Correction
applicability: If MC > Abs: aggregate adds free water (reduce batch water). If MC < Abs: aggregate absorbs water (increase batch water).

title: Unit Weight of Fresh Concrete (Theoretical)
equation: γ_c = C + W + CA + FA + (SCM) per m³
applicability: Sum of all material masses per m³. Typical: 2240–2400 kg/m³ for normal weight. Verify against measured unit weight (ASTM C138).

title: Yield

Y.description: Volume of concrete produced by batch

γ_c.description: Measured unit weight of fresh concrete

applicability: If Y < expected: concrete overweight (too little air or aggregate error). Adjust.

title: Air Content Effect on Strength (Rule of Thumb)
equation: Δf'c ≈ -5% per 1% air increase (for constant w/c)
applicability: Approximate. Actual varies 2–6% per 1% air. Air-entrained mixes need lower w/c to match non-AE strength.
